Wrote the reader report at [frontier-18-reader-7.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-18-reader-7.md). I repaired three confirmed fatal defects in batch 7:

- `ex-a-dense-open-subset-of-the-unit-interval-of-small-measure`: the proof only gave `\le \varepsilon`, while the item claimed `< \varepsilon`; I shrank the interval radii so the strict bound is now proved.
- `ex-a-dense-null-g-delta-set-containing-the-rationals`: the proof only handled `[-N,N]`, while the item claimed full measure on every bounded interval; I rewrote the last step to prove the interval-by-interval statement.
- `ex-the-graph-of-a-continuous-real-function-is-lebesgue-null-in-the-plane`: step `1.1` used compactness as if it already supplied uniform continuity; I replaced that with an explicit Heine-Cantor plus partition argument.

I updated the affected item files, the batch manifest entry that needed new deps, and [frontier-18-batch-7.proof-contracts.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-18-batch-7.proof-contracts.json). `reflow`, `precheck` on the three changed items, and `proof-contract --strict` on the batch all pass. The report also records that `citation-fidelity` still leaves 11 widening candidates elsewhere in the batch and `boundary-audit` still leaves one machine candidate on `lem-coordinate-scalings-and-permutations-scale-the-unit-cube-by-the-absolute-determinant`; I did not confirm a concrete defect from those in the items I directly opened.
